answer_2.quote: Evaluation metrics include: (1) Fingerprint Tanimoto Similarity (FTS)  for chemical similarity between generated and ground-truth molecules using Morgan, MACCS, and RDK fingerprints; (2) Formula accuracy (Formula Acc), which measures the correctness of chemical formulas of generated molecules; and (3) ACC for the exact structural match.
